fields.name: Program Homework Assignment
fields.description: Primary label Mike edits (or leave blank and use Display). Prefer one row per Program Instance + Week + Grade Band + Slot.

fields.name: Homework Assignment
fields.description: Link ONE reusable FBC Curriculum - SYNC library record. Do not put season Week scheduling only on the library — schedule here.

fields.name: Program Instance
fields.description: Which season/program this assignment belongs to (e.g. Shooting Challenge | 2026-2027).

fields.name: Week
fields.description: Challenge week this homework is due/assigned. Reuse the same library across weeks by creating separate PHA rows.

fields.name: Grade Band
fields.description: Grade band that receives this assignment (K-2, 3-4, 5-6, 7-8, 9-12).

fields.name: Homework Slot
fields.description: HW1 or HW2 — matches Submission Asset Purpose / Fillout slot.

fields.name: Active?
fields.description: Unchecked = ignored by Automation 033 / 020. Use to retire without deleting.

fields.name: Program Instance RID
fields.description: Lookup helper for Schedule Key — do not edit.

fields.name: Week RID
fields.description: Lookup helper for Schedule Key — do not edit.

fields.name: Grade Band RID
fields.description: Lookup helper for Schedule Key — do not edit.

fields.name: Homework Assignment RID
fields.description: Lookup helper for Schedule Key — do not edit.

fields.name: Schedule Key
fields.description: Auto dedupe fingerprint: ProgramInstance|Week|GradeBand|Slot|Homework. Two Active rows with the same key = operator error.
fields.formula:
IF(
  AND(
    {fld37Vw1oLvknFRHj},
    {fldFCQ2z9Bwg1Y8YY},
    {fld4Dpsd837yGkoPX},
    {fldtNNM0a6DoxmuaF},
    {fld0fcG9TDBXBlVDc}
  ),
  ARRAYJOIN({fld37Vw1oLvknFRHj}) & "|" & ARRAYJOIN({fldFCQ2z9Bwg1Y8YY}) & "|" & ARRAYJOIN({fld4Dpsd837yGkoPX}) & "|" & {fldtNNM0a6DoxmuaF} & "|" & ARRAYJOIN({fld0fcG9TDBXBlVDc}),
  BLANK()
)

fields.name: Program Homework Assignment Display
fields.description: Read-only human summary: Library | Program | Week | Grade Band | Slot.

fields.name: Homework Completions
fields.description: Inverse link — completions that resolved to this scheduled assignment.

fields.name: Operator Status
fields.description: At-a-glance health for Mike: Incomplete / Active / Inactive. Fix Incomplete before relying on Automation 033.
fields.formula:
IF(
  OR(
    NOT({fld32hpKiGx5l8ZhI}),
    NOT({fldrB2gcduTaqxnsl}),
    NOT({fld3S4XdwY6sq4BPZ}),
    NOT({fldWNwh6Z3pxVwTes}),
    NOT({fldtNNM0a6DoxmuaF})
  ),
  "Incomplete — fill Homework, Program, Week, Grade Band, Slot",
  IF(
    {fldxXLOeCHh09iObk},
    "Active — will assign via 033 / resolve via 020",
    "Inactive — ignored by automations"
  )
)

fields.name: Operator Notes
fields.description: Freeform notes for why this week/slot uses this library record. Not read by automations.

fields.name: Completions Count
fields.description: How many Homework Completions link to this scheduled assignment.

fieldsOfInterest.name: Homework Completion Key
fieldsOfInterest.description: Identity helper: Enrollment|Week|Homework. One HC per enrollment+week+library preferred; 020 also scopes by Submission+slot.

fieldsOfInterest.name: Weekly Athlete Summary
fieldsOfInterest.description: LEGACY unused text field. Do not write. Canonical relationship is Weekly Athlete Summary Link.

fieldsOfInterest.name: Completion Summary
fieldsOfInterest.formula:
IF(
  {fldh4ohAiEdp8oejg},
    IF(
      {fldLgx4GGYyfsajd5},
      "Satisfactory + Extra Credit",
      "Satisfactory"
    ),
    IF(
      {fld3QgYcH4AqQh6gP},
        {fld3QgYcH4AqQh6gP},
        BLANK()
    )
)

fieldsOfInterest.name: Weekly Athlete Summary Link
fieldsOfInterest.description: Canonical link to Weekly Athlete Summary. Written by Automation 020 (from Submission) / maintained for quiz via 067 patterns.

fieldsOfInterest.name: Homework
fieldsOfInterest.description: Reusable FBC Curriculum - SYNC library record (not the schedule row).

fieldsOfInterest.name: Program Homework Assignment
fieldsOfInterest.description: Scheduled junction row (PHA). Written by Automation 020 when resolvable. Library Homework link remains required for XP/display.

fieldsOfInterest.name: Homework
fieldsOfInterest.description: Assigned reusable library homework for this week (from Automation 033 via Program Homework Assignments when present, else legacy curriculum Week+Grade Band match). Perfect Week / rollups read this list.

fieldsOfInterest.name: Perfect Week Zoom Requirement Status
fieldsOfInterest.formula:
IF(
  {fldyFlpiRQiTpCKJz} != "Ready",
  "Not Calculated",
  IF(
    {fld1sBnbfMiunNlcW} = 0,
    "No Zoom This Week",
    IF(
      {fldVs5IgC7PnCXCYM} >= 1,
      "Attended",
      "Missed"
    )
  )
)

fieldsOfInterest.name: Perfect Week Calculation Queue?
fieldsOfInterest.formula:
IF(
  AND(
    LEN(ARRAYJOIN({fldNH81lfwL5dBnAw})) > 0,
    LEN(ARRAYJOIN({fldNUSqzr3H0PE5Ex})) > 0,
    LEN(ARRAYJOIN({fldNvhGv57qOqbsfN})) > 0,
    OR(
      {fldyFlpiRQiTpCKJz} = "Pending",
      {fldyFlpiRQiTpCKJz} = "Ready"
    )
  ),
  1,
  0
)

fieldsOfInterest.name: Perfect Week Homework Requirement Status
fieldsOfInterest.formula:
IF(
  {fldyFlpiRQiTpCKJz} != "Ready",
  "Not Calculated",
  IF(
    {fldZmafiSNvvDOBLi} = 0,
    "Not Required - No Homework This Week",
    IF(
      {fldK2cIQXX18OTdhS} = 1,
      "Complete - 100%",
      "Incomplete - " & ROUND({fld3eEpTebFgqTWYy} * 100, 0) & "%"
    )
  )
)

fieldsOfInterest.name: Homework Display
fieldsOfInterest.description: Shows homework name(s) or a red no symbol with 'No Homework' if none assigned.
